label: Entailment
quotes: provided that that Party takes whatever steps are necessary to procure that such professional advisors agree to abide by the terms of this Agreement
“third party” means any party other than Client and AfriGIS and their holding and subsidiary companies or agents
is disclosed to a third party pursuant to the prior written authorisation of the Disclosing Party
reason: Agents are excluded from the third-party restriction, clause 3.4's proviso for professional advisors only makes sense if disclosure to them is allowed (the 'may not' looks like a drafting error), and disclosure to third parties with prior written authorisation is allowed, so some sharing is permitted.
